# TigerQuery 0.8.9

TigerQuery 0.8.9 ships the TigerQuery libraries, the `ItTiger.TigerSqlCmd` .NET tool, and a new
Windows installer for TigerSqlCmd. Its privacy statement (`PRIVACY.md`) and licence (`LICENSE`)
are attached to this release and apply to exactly this version.

## TigerSqlCmd Windows installer

The installer is now built with TigerSetup and is named `TigerSqlCmd-0.8.9-Setup.exe`.

- **Upgrading from 0.8.8 is automatic.** The new installer finds the earlier Inno Setup
  installation, removes it with its own uninstaller, and then installs 0.8.9. Saved connections,
  their DPAPI-protected passwords, and your scripts, result files and logs are kept.
- **New install location.** TigerSqlCmd now installs to `%ProgramFiles%\TigerSqlCmd` (it was
  `%ProgramFiles%\ItTiger\TigerSqlCmd\cli`), and the system `PATH` entry moves with it. Open a
  new terminal after installing. Update any script that calls `tiger-sqlcmd.exe` by its full
  path; scripts that call `tiger-sqlcmd` from `PATH` keep working.
- **The .NET 10 Runtime is installed when it is missing.** The installer downloads Microsoft's
  runtime installer from Microsoft, at the address the WinGet catalog lists, and runs it only when
  its SHA-256 matches the hash the catalog publishes. No download
  happens when the runtime is already present. Uninstalling TigerSqlCmd keeps the runtime.
- **New command line.** Unattended installation is now
  `TigerSqlCmd-0.8.9-Setup.exe install --quiet`, and removal is
  `TigerSqlCmd-0.8.9-Setup.exe uninstall --quiet`, or **Settings > Apps**. The Inno Setup switches
  (`/VERYSILENT`, `/INSTALLDOTNET`) no longer apply. `--json` prints a machine-readable result.
  The exit code is `0` on success and `3010` when Windows must restart; every other code is a
  documented failure.
- The installer asks for administrator approval, as before, and installs for all users. The
  option to add TigerSqlCmd to the system `PATH` is on by default
  (`--option path off` turns it off).
- An install or upgrade either completes or is rolled back. If it is interrupted, the next run
  finishes it or undoes it.
- The installation now includes `LICENSE.txt`, `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` and `PRIVACY.md`. The
  Start Menu entry **TigerSqlCmd** still opens a command prompt that shows `tiger-sqlcmd --help`.

WinGet users get the new installer with `winget upgrade ItTiger.TigerSqlCmd`. The package
identifier is unchanged.

## TigerSqlCmd

- **Clearer connection failures.** The error names the saved connection and keeps SQL Server's
  own message, error number, state and class.
- **Undecryptable stored passwords.** A saved password that cannot be decrypted (for example,
  in a store copied from another Windows account) is now reported as exactly that, before any
  login is attempted.
- **Passwords that cannot be stored.** On Linux and macOS, `connection add` and
  `connection edit` now refuse a typed password, which the store cannot protect there, and
  point to `--password-reference`. Previously they reported success and discarded the password.
- **Security fix.** A password connection option padded with a space (`--opt " Password=..."`)
  slipped past the sensitive-option check and was saved in plain text. It is now refused.
- Failures that read external values, and E2E failures, now keep their cause: a missing file
  versus denied access, the position of a JSON error, or the SQL Server error.
- **Log files.** `--log-file` now records an error's type and message, and those of the errors
  that caused it, instead of a full exception dump with stack traces.
- **Shell completion.** `tiger-sqlcmd --completion bash|zsh|fish|pwsh` prints a tab-completion
  script.

## Libraries and dependencies

- `ItTiger.TigerQuery.Core` reports an undecryptable or missing stored password, and the cause
  of an external-value failure, before a connection is attempted.
- Microsoft.Data.SqlClient 7.1.1. `System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs` is now referenced directly
  at 10.0.13, which keeps CVE-2026-84008 and CVE-2026-70162 out of the packages and the installer.
- TigerCli and ItTiger.Core 0.9.5.

## Third-party software

`THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` lists the third-party components that TigerSqlCmd's installer and .NET
tool include, with their licences.
